story.iWant: to see target text with visual feedback as I type
story.soThat: I can clearly track my typing progress and errors in real-time
story.tasks: - Implement TypingEngine component with character-by-character validation (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Set up React state for target text, typed text, and cursor position - Implement character comparison logic for real-time validation - Apply Tailwind CSS classes for correct (green) and incorrect (red) styling - Implement smooth cursor animation between character positions - Create TypingSession interface and data models (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Define TypingSession TypeScript interface with session metadata - Define CharacterResult interface for individual character validation - Implement session state management using React hooks - Implement visual feedback system (AC: 1, 2, 3) - Create character highlighting logic for correct/incorrect states - Add ARIA labels for accessibility compliance - Implement cursor positioning and animation using CSS transitions - Add error counter display with real-time updates - Add accessibility and UX enhancements (AC: 1) - Ensure keyboard navigation support for screen readers - Add proper ARIA labels and descriptions - Test with screen reader compatibility

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Given I am on a typing practice page, when the target text is displayed, then each character is properly rendered with appropriate styling and a cursor shows the current typing position and typed characters are highlighted as correct (green) or incorrect (red) and the cursor animates smoothly between characters.
2. Given I am typing text, when I type a correct character, then the character turns green and the cursor advances and typing metrics update in real-time.
3. Given I am typing text, when I type an incorrect character, then the character turns red with error indication and the cursor stays at the error position and error counter increments.
